name: vibemaestro
description: Marketplace of the vibemaestro plugins for Claude Code sessions: vibemaestro-sdlc (the intent, spec, plan, ship process) and vibemaestro-brain (hot memory for long sessions, which brings sdlc as a dependency)

plugins.name: vibemaestro-sdlc
plugins.description: The intent -> spec -> plan -> ship process and the rule lookup hooks for a Claude Code session in an app repo

plugins.name: vibemaestro-brain
plugins.description: Hot memory for long-running sessions that survives compaction, on top of vibemaestro-sdlc (installed with it as a dependency): the brain CLI with a hash-chained op log, item operations only, and owner decisions written only through the permission dialog
